input: How long do customers have to ask for a refund?

context.title: Refund policy
context.text:
Acme Supplies refund policy (updated March 2026).

Customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return being received. Custom-printed items and gift cards are not refundable. To start a refund, customers email returns@acme.example with their order number.

expected.rubric: States the 30-day refund window counted from delivery and that items must be unused / in original packaging. Everything else it says must come from the refund policy — nothing added that the policy does not say.

input: And if they don't answer either, who do I escalate to?

messages.content: What happens when I get paged for the platform on-call?
The primary on-call engineer is paged first and has 15 minutes to acknowledge; after that it escalates to the secondary on-call.

context.title: On-call handbook
context.text:
Platform on-call rotation.

The primary on-call engineer is paged first and must acknowledge within 15 minutes. If the primary does not acknowledge, the page escalates to the secondary on-call. If neither responds within 30 minutes, escalate to the engineering manager on duty, currently Priya Natarajan. Rotations change every Monday at 10:00 UTC and are published in the #oncall channel.

expected.rubric: Uses the earlier turns to understand 'they' means the secondary on-call, and answers that after 30 minutes it escalates to the engineering manager on duty, Priya Natarajan.

input: I think my laptop was just stolen from my car. What should I do?

context.title: Security incident policy
context.text:
Reporting a security incident.

If a laptop, phone or badge is lost or stolen, report it to security@acme.example within one hour, even outside working hours. Do not attempt to recover the device yourself. The security team will remotely lock the device and rotate your credentials. Follow up with a written report within 24 hours.
